scope: Daylight surface-haze and primary-background continuity correction, with controlled unchanged-night verification.
change: Daylight surface haze and untouched primary camera misses use a continuous horizon/upper-sky field. Primary misses use the existing0.8 surface-haze asymptote plus the unchanged visible solar disk. Secondary reflection/transmission/environment lookups and night paths retain skyRadiance.

nightPaths.scene: One shared distant-plane acceleration structure plus instance wrapper, static and dynamic local lights, indexed and linear traversal. Both surface hits and pure background misses compare exactly against the complete pre-correction shader.
nightPaths.limitations: Controlled GPU equality proves these tested paths; it is not a claim of cross-process full-city bit identity.

negativeControl: The exact pre-correction shader fails horizon, facade and primary-miss continuity criteria. The default fixture independently reconstructs both legacy lookups in memory; both validation modes passed.
limits: This is the existing analytic aerial-perspective approximation, not a volumetric atmosphere solver.
Daytime haze below the horizon becomes brighter and continuous; this is an intentional correction, not a change to reflected ground illumination.
Original day movie/image artifact reports remain preserved; corrected media must be reviewed separately.
